customPresets: Replace the compaction-basic provider with @missher/dsh-context-manager/engine explicitly. Saved preset overrides take precedence.

runtimeCapabilities.idleMaintenanceSelection: Plugin-owned selection inside Agent.runMaintenance; no Basic selection hook required
runtimeCapabilities.protectedToolPruning: toolResultPruner.supportsProtectedSeqs === true; missing capability skips pruning
runtimeCapabilities.durableMetadata: Existing storageDomain schemas plus a plugin-owned pending metadata journal; no session/learning migration
runtimeCapabilities.summaryAbortCommit: Plugin-owned transaction checks AbortSignal immediately before synchronous Session replacement
runtimeCapabilities.storageShutdownDrain: Writable profileContext.dir/.context-manager-recovery journal; Host registerDrain used when available. Custom embedding without profile path requires Host drain.

verification.distribution: 0.8.0-local.8: frozen plugin-owned transaction and recovery journal; old/enhanced SDK checks and two cold old-Host starts on Intel macOS. See PUBLICATION.md; Linux/Windows native installation remains unverified.
verification.officialHarnessOnly: Full plugin acceptance on unmodified official rc.2 was not performed. Missing optional capabilities follow runtimeCapabilities.
verification.presetSourceShaMeaning: sourceSha identifies the preset-source baseline, not an assertion of full compatibility with that commit.
